Tuesday, March 9, 2027 at SHACK15, on the second floor of the Ferry Building in San Francisco. Doors open at 9 AM. How do I get a ticket? Registration coming soon. We’ll post the registration link here when it’s ready. You can add the date to your calendar now. Who is speaking? Samuel Colvin and Jeremiah Lowin are confirmed. More speakers and the full schedule will be announced here. Do I need to use Python? No. PyAI is open to developers, researchers, and anyone building with AI, whatever language they use. Is there an event afterward? Yes. We’re planning an evening gathering after the conference. The location, timing, and registration details will be shared here. Can I watch last year’s talks? Yes.
